answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, in each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial tied to Semaphore membership and RLN rate limits. Each message proves valid inclusion and identity binding without revealing the secret. Reusing a nullifier creates two polynomial evaluations at one point; their difference enables Shamir secret-sharing reconstruction of the agent’s private key, triggering deterministic, immediate collateral slashing. A garden, plume, or terrace of aliases therefore cannot safely amplify voting power.
